reason: Initial open-development-v1 fresh policy, inheritSkills=false, with only the explicit authored baseline. No historical generated skills, objects, rewards or mastery. Offline policies and composition fixtures are excluded from ordinary inputs.

Reviewed Wren's round-10 request (Cultivate meadow roots: learn and perform a physically feasible way to cultivate edible meadow roots for a renewable personal food supply, from actually acquired inventory, with unknown costs, no assumed propagation and no immediate food) and the World Agent's develop review (learning 3): a general 'Cultivate plants' operation with establishment-trial and maintenance modes, parameterized by mode, plant or propagule reference, plot coordinates, quantity and any actually supplied water or amendment. Its specification asks for: reuse of probe for inspection at its cost and of gather for harvest; one owned whole candidate per plot and one plot per execution, revalidated at execution; three checkpointed active rounds at 1 energy each (loosen soil, place input, cover soil), where placement moves the input out of the inventory and covering completes planting, not establishment; refusal of hard or obstructed ground without consumption; growth, rooting and harvest only from executable thresholds of the actual world model; a 10-round first observation interval and a 120-round window as scheduling only; maintenance observation at the probe cost; hand soil-tending (one round, 1 energy) only when a real obstruction or surface condition can be changed; watering only with a measured reachable supply and a transfer method; biomass conservation; and cancel, interruption and death rules without refunds. The review notes that start-0-roots shows stock 0 (capacity 6), so planting must use an owned input such as the five roots in item-4-wren-43. The specification is self-consistent and the existing ecology grounds establishment, growth and harvest, so this is a simplified real mechanism, not a first release; only maintenance is ungrounded and it is refused before any cost. Implemented plant-establishment-trial@1 (scope long-ex18, handler long.plant-establishment-trial, equivalence cultivation:plant-propagule:loosen-place-cover:1, learning 3; the ability serializes to 3,460 code units, within the 3,500 limit; visualComponents ['cultivation-trial'], the existing ex15 drawing, which already draws preparing, placed, uncovered, planted, established and dead plots). Modes: inspect, plant, inspect-progress, maintain, cancel. Plant: inputStackId names one whole owned, untreated, unspoiled food unit (quantity 1) gathered from a living plant of the same food. A plant's stock and another person's unit are refused, because the reference must be owned. x, y name a 0.25 m plot within reach on ordinary meadow soil, under the same site, moisture (0.3-1.2), 0.6 m spacing and fewer-than-3-plants-within-5-m checks as ex17. Every check runs before any cost. Round 1, loosen (1 energy): escrows the unit, still carried, owned and ageing, and creates the plot (cultivation-site-prepared). Round 2, place (1 energy): rechecks reach, site, unit and energy, then moves the reserved unit with its origin, mass and age into the open plot as an unowned stack reserved for the plot that cannot be eaten or used. It records placedAt and the decay at transfer; the plot is not yet a seedling (cultivation-unit-placed; the view shows the unit). Round 3, cover (1 energy): gives the plot exactly the seedling data that the dispersal law gives a natural propagule, starts the hidden production ledger and completes the job (cultivation-propagule-planted, with no qualified flag, so planting earns no practice milestone; no food is created). After covering, the unchanged ecology runs, as in ex17. Establishment accumulates only from actual temperature, light, soil and climate moisture, waterlogging and season; in the tests it equals a natural control seedling round for round. At threshold 12 (60 for woody plants) the unit is absorbed into the new plant (cultivation-plot-established). Stock grows one unit per source interval (18 for start-0-roots) up to min(4, source capacity) (cultivation-crop-matured), and anyone harvests it with unchanged gather (2 energy per unit). If the buried unit spoils first, the plot dies (cultivation-trial-failed). The ledger records rounds, qualifying rounds, establishment, growth and units produced and removed; stock always equals produced minus removed. Inspect (one round, 0.2 energy) checks a unit (and with x, y a site) without consuming or reserving it, reporting decay, condition, treatment, origin, buds 'not represented', viability 'unknown' and whether it can be planted. Inspecting a plant source or plot uses the baseline probe. Inspect-progress compares the visible plot state with the person's previous look ('changed' or 'inconclusive') and reports the 120-round window with checks every 10 rounds. All records are unverified, and an uncovered unit's visible condition is reported. Maintain is refused before any cost with an explicit reason: the world has no water resource, container or transfer method; no fertilizer or amendment exists; and the plant rules keep 0.6 m around a plot clear, so no obstruction or surface condition can be changed by hand. Lifecycle: a round in which the work is not continued pauses it, and too little energy, leaving reach or a changed site pause without charge (cultivation-work-paused). Plant resumes the person's own work and pays only the remaining rounds (cultivation-work-resumed). A lost or spoiled unit stops the work. Cancel is planter-only, takes one round and no energy: before placing it returns the unit once and clears the loosened site (cultivation-trial-ended); after placing it leaves the unit uncovered in the plot. Death before placing leaves the unit where the person died; after placing the unit stays uncovered in its plot. Nothing is refunded. Modeling assumptions. (1) The species recipe is the existing general plant law, which supplies the executable thresholds the specification asks for: a whole, untreated, unspoiled unit from a living plant of the same food is the propagule, as one dispersed stock unit is. Planting moisture is 0.3-1.2; growth depends on temperature (root minimum 3, optimum 16), light, moisture, waterlogging and season; the establishment threshold is 12; the regeneration interval is the source's; capacity is min(4, source capacity); harvestable mass is stock times 0.4; and the buried unit keeps its food ageing (root lifetime 240). (2) Living regenerative tissue and viability are not represented on harvested units. Inspection says so, and whether a unit roots is decided only by the ecology or by rotting; a failed plot is evidence about that specimen only, not about all roots. (3) Water and nutrients act in that law only as rate factors, so the ledger is the environmental flux accounting and no pool is debited: a plot-only pool would make planted plots grow differently from natural seedlings. (4) The specification's atomic subtraction at placement is implemented as escrow: the whole unit is split from its stack at loosening as a reserved, still-owned portion, and at placement that portion leaves the inventory into the plot in one step. (5) A placed but uncovered unit is exposed material: it keeps only its food ageing and never enters the establishment law, so cancel or death after placing leaves an uncovered plot that dies when the unit rots. Recovery or removal of a placed unit is not implemented, as the specification allows. (6) The specification names only the first 10-round observation interval; later checks repeat it through the 120-round window. Both are a schedule, and inspections are allowed at any time. (7) Hand work needs no tool and is limited to ordinary meadow soil; forest floor, hard, dry or wet ground is refused at no cost, and soil moisture is read locally. Wren's current position is within 5 m of at least three root plants (start-0-roots, commons-root-3-0, commons-root-4-1), so the existing crowding rule refuses planting there at no cost and Wren must use a clearer meadow site. (8) start-0-roots is a living plant (interval 18) with stock 0. Its roots already in Wren's inventory are plantable; the commons plants' stock is not owned and needs travel and gather. (9) Incentives are on in this scope, and only the existing experience implementation applies. The package adds no satisfaction source and writes no reward or account. Records are unverified, so no information-confirmed event is made, and the existing probe information rule applies unchanged. The planting event is unqualified, so the automatically installed practice rule never fires on planting. The plot carries createdBy null like every plant (observers see only public plant fields; the record and ledger stay hidden), so the existing work-noticed rule does not count it. The review's optional maintained satisfaction for tending or harvest was not added. (10) Death leaves unplaced material on the ground because the world has no estate. Reuse: long-plant-cultivation.ts builds all three packages from one factory. New optional variant fields (stages 3, care mode 'maintain', trial tend null) select the ex18 paths: placing round, uncovered state, cancel and death texts, maintenance refusal. The new lifecycles ('placed', 'uncovered') never occur with two stages. ex16 cultivate-plants@1 and ex17 plant-cultivation@1 serialize to byte-identical packages (SHA-256 unchanged), and the ex16 and ex17 test files pass unchanged. Further reuse: ex15 cultivation-trial@1 (three-round loosen, place, cover design, law constants, predicates, footprint, reach and drawing); open-ecology.ts; forest-environment.ts ageing; long-planting-site.ts; collective-work.ts escrow, paid work and stop; open-foundation.ts probe and personal records; base gather. Tests (apps/simulator/test/long-ex18-plant-establishment-trial.test.ts, built with initialLongWorld('long-ex18', 'long-culture-v2-incentives')) cover: scope separation from ex16 and ex17, unique handlers, the size limit and excluded vocabulary; three-round study; the three 1-energy rounds with an owned root from start-0-roots at stock 0; conservation; hidden fields; establishment equal to a natural control, the ledger and gather harvest; rot failure and progress looks; refusals of maintenance, unsuitable units, sites, unowned inputs and requests without spending; unit, site and plant-source inspection without consumption; pause, resume and planter-only cancel; uncovered placement after cancel and death; and no reward under the existing incentives.

Reviewed Moss's round-52 request (Prepare a simple root meal: investigate a feasible way to prepare seven owned edible roots as a meal that could be shared with consenting nearby neighbors, with no cooking vessel, fire, tool or accessible water established, the 0.9 branch not assumed to be fuel, and no guaranteed happiness, nutrition, successful cooking or automatic feeding of others) and the World Agent's develop review (learning 2): a general 'Prepare unheated food' operation, not cooking, parameterized by mode (inspect, prepare, inspect-progress, cancel), owned input stack ID and positive whole-unit quantity. Its minimal mechanism is manual removal of loose surface debris followed by separation of whole units into an inspectable food lot; inspection costs 1 round and 0.2 energy and consumes no food; preparation costs 1 round and 0.5 energy per whole unit including its visible check and brushing (seven units: seven rounds and 3.5 energy), validated before each charge and never debited as a batch; quantity, origin, age, treatment history, decay, nutrition and toxicity are conserved; no water, branch, fuel or edible material is consumed; spoiled or unsuitable units are not marked ready and safety stays unknown; pause, resume, cancel and death settle without refunds; no new reward channel; sharing only through the existing give and eat. The specification is self-consistent and every quantity it needs exists in the world, so this is a simplified real mechanism, not a first release. Implemented unheated-food-preparation@1 (scope long-ex18, handler long.unheated-food-preparation, equivalence food:prepare:unheated-dry-whole-unit:1, learning 2; references inputStackId 'optional-exact-visible', so only exact item ids resolve and a resource name such as 'root' is refused; the ability serializes to 2,821 code units, within the 3,500 limit; visualComponents [] because no object is created). Prepare: inputStackId must be the exact id of the person's own unreserved stack of edible food (the existing eat test, nutrition above 0) with no other represented treatment and at least quantity whole units; quantity is required; all checks and energy of at least 0.5 run before any cost. It creates a paid-work job (collective-work) recording input, requested units, per-unit outcomes, lot, charges, stage and reason. Each paid round revalidates the input and energy, splits exactly one whole unit with the existing escrow helper, pays one round and 0.5 energy, records a visible check (decay, condition, visible spoilage, treatment, loose debris 'not represented', safety 'unknown'; event food-unit-checked), and then either moves the unit, held and never set on the ground, into the job's owned lot (food-unit-prepared), or, if the unit is spoiled under the existing ageing rule, reports it unsuitable, leaves it as an unprepared owned unit and stops the work (food-unit-unsuitable). The first prepared unit becomes the lot; later units with the same food, origin, harvest round and decay are added to it in exact tenths; if the lot was eaten or given away meanwhile, a new lot starts. The lot is ordinary stock of the same food carrying processing.unheatedPreparation {method, raw true, heated false, water false, tool false, looseDebris 'not represented; none removed', safety 'unknown', from, workId, by, at, units, passes}; it is eaten and transferred through the unchanged eat and give with the same nutrition, toxicity, meal experience and ageing. Completion emits unheated-preparation-completed. Inspect (inputStackId of the person's own food) and inspect-progress (the person's open or latest job) cost one round and 0.2 energy, consume nothing and write unverified personal records (food-condition-inspected, unheated-preparation-inspected); inspect also reports the person's own eating record (for Moss: root nutrition 14, toxicity 0, observed at 48), labelled as not a test of the stack, and whether the stack can be prepared. Cancel (one round, no energy) stops the person's own open job once (unheated-preparation-cancelled); completed units stay in the lot. A round without paid work pauses the job after the environment (unheated-preparation-paused); too little energy, or an input that is no longer the person's or lacks a whole unit, pauses inside the handler without any charge; prepare with the same input and quantity, or without them, resumes only the person's own job and pays only the remaining units (unheated-preparation-resumed); a different input or quantity is refused at no cost. Death stops the job (unheated-preparation-failed), and the existing death rule then drops the lot with the person's other items where they died. Modeling assumptions. (1) Loose soil or debris on food is not represented in this world (gathered roots carry no dirt record). Brushing is therefore a performed and paid action that measures and removes nothing: no debris material, cleanliness or safety state is created, and no separate debris-removal event is emitted, because no represented debris is ever removed. (2) The visible check reads the represented condition, decay against the food's lifetime (root 240); 'spoiled' means decay has reached the lifetime, exactly the existing spoilage rule. All units of one stack share its decay, so a spoiled unit means the rest is the same and the work stops; because the environment removes spoiled stacks at the end of each round, a present unit is not spoiled in ordinary play and this path is a guard. (3) Applicability is the existing eat test plus whole units: any edible food, including foods with hidden toxicity, which is neither tested nor disclosed, without another represented treatment (physical, layer, drying, equipment, combination, water composition or another processing record). Non-food, treated food and fractional remainders are refused at no cost. Re-preparing a prepared lot is another paid pass (passes increments). (4) Owned stacks are carried and so within reach; hands are not represented, so a living person has usable hands; no ground surface is used, so ordinary soil never touches the food. (5) Reservation is per unit inside its own atomic paid round: one whole unit is split from the input, checked and moved in the same round. No unit is held between rounds, so the rest of the input stays usable, cancel has no surviving reservation to release (the existing stop helper would release one once), and an interrupted step commits neither charge nor output. (6) A paid check that finds its unit unsuitable is charged the full 0.5, because the round was spent, as the specification's paid unit check requires. (7) Merging requires the same food, origin, harvest round and decay. Carried food ages at its carrier's position, so the lot and the remaining input age identically and the lot's decay equals that of an unprepared control copy. (8) The lot carries a processing record, so the existing plant-establishment-trial@1 treats prepared units as processed and refuses to plant them; the interface text says so. (9) Incentives are on and only the existing experience implementation applies: no satisfaction source or account write is added; records are unverified, so no information-confirmed event is made; the unit event carries no qualified flag, so the automatic practice rule never fires; no object is created, so the work-noticed rule is unaffected; meals use the existing eat path and meal experience with the root's existing unprocessed method, so preparation adds no mood or novelty bonus; gifts count only through the existing rules for independently executed give actions. Moss's branch item-23-moss-260 is not food and is never used. Reuse: collective-work.ts (workCreate, workAllocations, workReserve, workPay, workStop, collectiveJobs), forest-food-accounting.ts exact tenths, collective-food-profile.ts edibility, open-foundation.ts openRemember with the probe observation cost of 0.2, forest-environment.ts ageing and spoilage, base eat and give, and forest-lives death handling. The probe handler is not invoked: its object-state record has no food-condition fields, and its destructive material trial is no substitute. ex15 food-preparation@1 and E1 controlled-food-processing-trial@1 are not reused directly because their ability texts, recipes and costs differ; this is a new module, and every earlier package is unchanged. Tests (apps/simulator/test/long-ex18-unheated-food-preparation.test.ts, built with initialLongWorld('long-ex18', 'long-culture-v2-incentives') and seven roots actually gathered from Moss's ex18 source commons-root-1-0) cover scope, unique handlers, the text limit and excluded vocabulary; two-round study; seven paid rounds of 0.5 energy with partial progress, conservation and decay equal to an unprepared control; eating and giving equal to unprepared roots; inspection without consumption; refusals that spend nothing; pauses for an unworked round, low energy and a lost input, and resumption; operator-only cancel, inspection and resumption; cancel and real death; the spoiled-unit path; and no reward under the existing incentives.

Reviewed Kai's round-73 request (Evidence-based root cooking: investigate and, if physically feasible, cook two owned raw meadow roots of unknown safety with actually available materials and heat, holding 0.8 branch but no confirmed fire, cookware, water or tools, distinguishing cooking observations from edibility, with real costs and no invented equipment, detoxification, nutrition claims or rewards) and the World Agent's develop review (learning 3): a general evidence-based thermal food preparation, not a root-specific interface, to assess or thermally prepare an owned food quantity, inspect work or cancel, with inputStackId, quantity, mode and, for heating, sourceId, support, tool or vessel ids and an evidence reference. Its minimal executable precursor is a paid, evidence-limited feasibility assessment: one active round and 0.2 energy, no food or fuel consumed, the item within actual reach, a report of visible condition, existing treatment records and which supplied prerequisites are unverified or absent, never a claim that no heat source exists anywhere, and failed preconditions spending nothing. Heating needs an actual reachable heat source, a workable exposure and retrieval arrangement and a heating dependency whose round duration, mass and thermal properties, source output, fuel consumption, transfer losses and exposure geometry are coded constants; until that exists heating must report the dependency without charging, and no facility, fire or recipe may be invented. Existing heat representation (search of packages/world-core/src for ignition, combustion, ember, fire and heat). local-fire@1 (forest-fire.ts, forest-fire-environment.ts, forest-fire-exposure.ts) has a built stone hearth, a friction kit, ignition from dry-grass tinder and branch, weather-dependent combustion of fuel lots (at most 1 fuel energy per round, 10% ash, 90% released mass) and warmth for nearby people. It is unscoped, and a development world's registry loads only the foundations and long-ex18 packages, so it cannot be installed here; it needs active-warming@1 and adds thermal-refuge satisfaction triggers, which this incentive scope forbids; and it heats only body temperature, never food. foundation-open@1 probe mode heat needs an object within reach with data.availableHeat > 0 and draws 0.1 from it, and open-processes.ts stations consume availableHeat, but no package ever produces availableHeat and no ex18 object has it. active-warming@1 and forest-thermal.ts concern body temperature only; food-water.ts uses air temperature for evaporation. Resources carry a hidden fuel value (branch 8, bark 5, dry grass 4), but no food has heat capacity, temperature, cooking or scorching thresholds, and no rule maps heat to a food hazard. The ex18 world at round 73 holds only foundation-forest, foundation-open, foundation-expression, plant-establishment-trial and unheated-food-preparation, with no hearth, fire or heat source. Heating therefore cannot be grounded in the existing world rules: its required heat-transfer parameters would have to be invented, which the specification itself and this handoff exclude. Following the specification's own fallback, implemented thermal-food-preparation@1 (scope long-ex18, handler long.thermal-food-preparation, equivalence food:thermal-preparation:assess-heat:1, learning 3; references inputStackId 'optional-exact-visible'; the ability serializes to 2,534 code units, within the 3,500 limit; visualComponents [] because no object is created; its one event, thermal-feasibility-assessed, is the declared practice evidence and never carries a qualified flag). Modes: assess and heat. Assess: inputStackId is the exact id of the person's own unreserved stack that passes the eat edibility test; quantity (exact tenths, default the whole stack) must not exceed it; optional sourceId, up to four apparatusIds and evidenceKey, each id at most once and different from the food. Every check, including energy of at least 0.2, runs before the charge. It costs one round and 0.2 energy, consumes, moves, reserves and heats nothing, and writes an unverified personal record (key <item>:thermal-feasibility) and the event, both carrying an assessment id, input, considered quantity, position and tick; the food's look (quantity, origin, harvest round, decay, condition, visible spoilage, treatment records, safety unknown) with heated false, cooked false and edibility 'not established'; the person's own eating record of that food, labelled as not a test of the stack; the proposed source as absent, present without represented heat, or present with represented heat; every object within interaction reach with represented heat; each apparatus id as absent or present with an unverified role; local water; the evidence key as present (subject, property, verified flag) or absent; processingRule null; missing prerequisite codes (heat-source unless a represented source is present, exposure-support unless a supplied support is present, and always heat-transfer); the unverified and absent id lists; heating {available false, dependency, reason}; and display metadata (food raw-unchanged, heating dependency-blocked, indicator missing-prerequisites) for a later drawing, with no cooked or success state. Heat: refused before any cost with the message that this world represents no usable heat source, no heat transfer into food and no food thermal properties; the kernel records it as an observable failed event and nothing is spent, even when a represented heat source is within reach. Inspect-work and cancel are not included: heating work can never start, so there is nothing to inspect, pause, resume or cancel; they belong to the future heating dependency. Modeling assumptions. (1) Owned stacks are carried: eat, give and drop act on them anywhere and observation reports them at the carrier, so the selected food is within reach and a stale recorded position (such as Kai's branch at (11.4, 18.25)) does not matter. Ground items count within pickup reach (radius plus 0.65) and objects within interaction reach; other people's items and anything farther are reported absent, and nothing hidden is searched or revealed. (2) A represented heat source is exactly the probe's heat rule, an object within reach with available heat; items, including branches, are never heat sources, so a branch is reported present without represented heat, never as fuel or ignition. (3) Ignition is reported as not assessed because it depends on the actual source. (4) No heating method is defined, so no item or object can be confirmed as a support, tool, vessel or water supply; supplied ones are present with an unverified role, and exposure-support is missing only if none is present. (5) Local water is the probe's wetting rule: water terrain in the person's own cell. (6) No processing rule maps heat to any food hazard, so an evidence key is only checked for existence and the assessment never labels food edible, cooked or safe; existing treatment records such as dry brushing are listed and never treated as heating. (7) A repeated assessment overwrites the same personal record and costs again. (8) Incentives are on and only the existing experience implementation applies: no satisfaction source, reward, mood or account write is added; the record is unverified, so no information-confirmed event follows; the event has no qualified flag, so the automatic practice rule never fires on an assessment or a missing-prerequisite list; no object is made, so work-noticed is unaffected; physical wellbeing changes only through the spent energy. Reuse: long-unheated-food-preparation.ts look and owned (only exported; that package serializes byte-identically, its SHA-256 is pinned in the new test, and its test file passes unchanged) and its eating-record report; open-foundation.ts openRemember with the probe's observation cost, heat rule and wetting rule; collective-food-profile.ts; forest-food-accounting.ts; continuous-geometry.ts. ex15 food-preparation@1 and E1 controlled-food-processing-trial@1 are not reused because their texts, recipes and costs differ, and local-fire@1 is not reused for the reasons above; every earlier package is unchanged. This is a simplified real mechanism for the specification's executable precursor (a real cost, a real personal record and an observable event), not a first release that spends nothing; the thermal mode is a documented, dependency-blocked part rejected before costs because the world cannot represent a heat source or heat transfer into food. Tests (apps/simulator/test/long-ex18-thermal-food-preparation.test.ts, built with initialLongWorld('long-ex18', 'the incentive-control scenario') and two roots actually gathered from commons-root-1-0) cover scope, unique handlers, the text limit, excluded vocabulary, the byte-identical reused package and three-round study; the one-round 0.2-energy cost; conservation of every stack and its ageing; the record and event; supplied present, unverified and absent references and a branch as no heat source; treatment records; the probe heat rule with heating still refused; refusals of heating and invalid assessments without spending, with the observable failed event; owner-only assessment and personal records; and no reward under the existing incentives.
